symptoms.sts_start_stuck: The StatefulSet start is stuck on one Pod.

facts.sts_ordered_start: StatefulSet {sts} starts its Pods one by one and waits for each to be ready.
facts.sts_pods_not_created: Only {created} of {replicas} Pods have been created.
facts.sts_claim_not_bound: Claim {pvc} from the volume template is not bound (phase: {phase}).
facts.sts_update_partitioned: The update is limited by partition {partition}: {updated} of {replicas} replicas are updated.
facts.sts_pods_on_old_revision: {count} Pod(s) still run the previous revision.

hypotheses.sts_stuck_ordered_start: StatefulSet {sts} does not create the next Pods until Pod {pod} is ready.
hypotheses.sts_pvc_pending: Claim {pvc} of StatefulSet {sts} is not bound, so its Pod cannot start.
hypotheses.sts_update_partitioned: The update of StatefulSet {sts} is stopped by partition {partition}; this may be intentional (a canary rollout).

recommendations.rec_fix_blocking_pod: Fix Pod {pod}: until it is ready, StatefulSet {sts} will not create the remaining Pods.
recommendations.rec_fix_statefulset_claim: Fix claim {pvc} (storage class, provisioner, capacity) so that StatefulSet {sts} can start its Pod.
recommendations.rec_lower_statefulset_partition: If the update should continue, lower the partition (now {partition}) of StatefulSet {sts}.

missing.statefulset_selector_missing: The StatefulSet has no selector, so its Pods cannot be found.
